parameters.query: SELECT (SELECT value #>> '{}' FROM acq.settings WHERE key = 'discovery.crawl_user_agent') AS user_agent

-- Only WEB leads with a real website and no current audit: the predicate is
-- inside the claim, so nothing is locked that this workflow cannot use.
SELECT id, clinic_name, website, domain, category
FROM acq.claim_leads_for_audit(10, $1)

nodes.name: Anything Claimed?
nodes.notes: alwaysOutputData emits one empty item when the claim returns nothing; this keeps it out of the loop.

nodes.name: Fetch robots.txt
nodes.notes: Missing or unreachable robots.txt is treated as 'allowed'.

nodes.name: Fetch Homepage
nodes.notes: One page per business. Continues on error: a site that does not load is itself the finding.

nodes.name: Record Audit
nodes.notes: Stores the audit, keeps any email found with its page as evidence, rescores (BLENDED) and either keeps the lead QUALIFIED or rejects it — one transaction.
